headline: Quiet day: Carney flags AI dependence, AI-designed vaccine clears trial
body: A quiet day. Ahead of the G7, Canada's Mark Carney said the US order that took Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 offline shows allies must not rely on a few US models. That is a crack in Global Coordination, which nudges Gatekeeper down. A lightly sourced report of an AI-designed vaccine component passing a first human trial added a little to Capability Velocity. Horizon Balance: +2.45.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Gatekeeper -0.07, from Carney's dependence warning (-0.08) and fading earlier news (-0.02), partly offset by the AI-designed vaccine trial (+0.03); Self-Destruction +0.05, from Carney's dependence warning (+0.05).
coming_up: G7 leaders' summit (upcoming; referenced by Carney, date not given in the event)
